newsitem.title: GERMANY: Grohe seeks growth with acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Grohe seeks growth with acquisitions.

text.p: Germany's Grohe AG said on Thursday it was aiming to raise its annual sales by about 50 percent to 1.8 billion marks by the turn of the century through acquisitions in Europe and America.
The German bathroom fittings manufacturer said it was prepared to spend about 300 million marks on acquisitions.
Grohe in 1996 reported a 1.5 percent rise in sales to 1.2 billion marks.

Despite intentions for acquisitions, Grohe management board chairman Klaus Weisshaar said the group would keep up its dividend policy. The group has proposed raising its 1996 dividends by 50 pfennigs to 16 marks per ordinary share and 17 marks for preference shares.
